'''Commando Leader Captain''' was a [[Military rank]] affiliated with the [[Trade Federation Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation]]. [[22D-R]] served as a [[Commando]] Leader [[Captain]] while assisting the [[B1-series battle droid]] [[OOM-9]] during the Trade Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]<ref name="Insiders" /> in [[32 BBY]].<ref name="Time">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of Commando Leader Captain was created for the revised rough draft of the [[prequel trilogy]] film {{Film|I}}, written by [[George Lucas]]. However, the character that held the rank, 22D-R, was ultimately cut from the finished film, and their role in the film was first mentioned in the CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]''.<ref name="Insiders" /> ''The Phantom Menace'' premiered on [[May 19]], [[1999]],<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> and the ''Insider's Guide'' was released on [[June 23]], 1999<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news19990623.html|text=''Star Wars:'' Episode I ''Insider's Guide''}}</ref>
